title: TAI orphan runtime role repair
objective: Repair only a strictly attested orphan tai_runtime PostgreSQL role when the standalone TAI service, dedicated environment and Compose override are all absent, then allow the existing fail-closed deployment to recreate the principal with a fresh secret.
boundaries: The repair is owner-only and bound to exact current main on issue 3365
No repair runs while a TAI container, dedicated env file or TAI Compose override exists
An existing role must be LOGIN, NOSUPERUSER, NOCREATEDB, NOCREATEROLE, NOINHERIT, NOREPLICATION, NOBYPASSRLS with connection limit 20
The role must have no memberships in either direction, no active sessions and no privileges on non-TAI relations
Only CONNECT, public schema usage and privileges on tai_* relations and sequences are revoked
DROP OWNED and REASSIGN OWNED are forbidden; any unexpected dependency makes DROP ROLE fail and rolls back the PostgreSQL transaction
Role absence is an idempotent PASS
The normal deployment remains responsible for fresh role creation, grants, runtime proof and rollback
No model, tenant, role, financial or autonomous write authority is widened
